data.cultural_impact: The name "Eftikhar" has a profound impact on Islamic culture, as it represents an esteemed character trait valued in Islam. In Islamic society, showing respect and honor to others is considered one of the key components of good character and moral living. The name "Eftikhar" is a reminder of the importance of treating others with dignity and respect, fostering a society of unity and mutual respect.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Eftikhar" holds deep significance as it reflects the importance of honoring and respecting God. In Islam, the belief is that Allah (God) is the ultimate source of all honor and respect, and that all praise and adoration belong to Him alone. The name "Eftikhar" serves as a reminder to always strive to live a life that is pleasing to God, and to treat others with the honor and respect that they deserve as children of the same Creator.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Proud, Honorable" symbolizes One who is given honor and respect. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Eftikhar serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of proud, honorable.
